title: Duplicate Videos on iPhone? Check Which Copy to Keep
description: Before deleting duplicate videos, compare the candidate copies’ content, duration and quality, then choose the one you actually want to retain.
direct: Before deleting duplicate videos, compare the candidate copies’ content, duration and quality, then choose the one you actually want to retain. A similar thumbnail alone does not prove two clips are interchangeable.

cards.choice.heading: Start with the decision
cards.choice.body: A short edited export and a longer camera original may begin on the same frame. One copy may have different sound, resolution or useful metadata. Treat duplicate groups as candidates for review rather than permission to remove everything that looks alike.
sections.detail-0.heading: Keep intentional variants
sections.detail-0.body: A smaller sharing copy can be useful alongside an original. An edited version may have captions, a different crop or a shortened introduction. Those differences matter even if much of the footage matches. If you cannot establish which file is expendable, leave that group alone and continue reviewing other candidates.
sections.detail-1.heading: What our app provides
sections.detail-1.body: Space Sheep Studio develops Phone Cleaner for iPhone, formerly presented as Video Compressor under the same App Store ID. Its current listing includes Storage Clean, duplicate-video review and choosing which copy to keep. Compression is a separate optional task. No perfect matching accuracy, automatic safe deletion or guaranteed storage-recovery amount is claimed here.

steps.step-1.text: Open Storage Clean in Phone Cleaner: Photo & Video and review the duplicate-video candidates. Keep important footage backed up before deleting copies.
steps.step-2.text: Play each candidate, including the ending and sound. Compare duration and the available file details; check which copy contains the footage you need.
steps.step-3.text: Select the copy to keep and review the deletion selection before confirming. Afterwards, open the retained video and verify that it still plays as expected.
